newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIA-Mata securities recommends buying Unit '64.
newsitem.headline: INDIA-Mata securities recommends buying Unit '64.

text.p: Indian money market dealer Mata Securities said it recommended banks and financial institutions to buy Unit '64, a mutual fund unit from India's leading fund Unit Trust of India (UTI).
Mata said it recommended Unit '64 for the following reasons:
* Unit'64 has continued to offer above 14 percent returns under the worst market scenario.
* It is the only money market instrument available in sizable quantities.
* It has buy-back facility, thereby limiting downside, and assured liquidity in the event of a cash crunch.
* After dematerilisation, there will be no transfer stamp charges and the transfer will become extremely simple and efficient.
* Very large corpus assures stability of returns and depth.
* It has large holding of public sector units (PSU) shares which have come into limelight of late.
* It has a history of being very liquid money market instrument.
